Package de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix

Class SparseMatrix

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix
de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.SparseMatrix
public class SparseMatrix extends Matrix
Sparse matrix backed by a Dictionary-of-Keys (DOK) representation: a HashMap keyed by the encoded (row, col) index. Supports cheap incremental setAsDouble(double, long, long) (the equivalent of scipy's lil_matrix build phase) and converts to CSRMatrix for compute-heavy paths via toCSR().

Compute kernels (mtimes(Matrix), plus(Matrix) etc.) materialise to dense or convert to CSR internally -- no attempt is made to keep results sparse. The trust-constr port only relies on sparsity in a handful of well-known places (Jacobian storage and the AUGMENTED_SYSTEM KKT factorization, both of which already drop into the CSR fast paths).
